svg.aria-label: Private area at /admin since v2.0.0: Contact inbox, traffic KPIs (v2.1.0), Magic (v2.2.0). English only, noindex, disallowed in robots.txt. Access: Supabase Auth magic link for one admin user. Middleware, requireAdmin() and Postgres RLS via public.is_admin() check it. No service-role key. Admin UUID: Lives in src/config/admin.ts and in the migration. Change both together. Migrations: In supabase/migrations/. Apply them in the Supabase SQL editor. Secrets: Analytics needs ANALYTICS_INGEST_SECRET in Vercel. The Magic catalog loader needs SUPABASE_DB_URL. Everything else: Every table, setup step, keyboard shortcut and Supabase Auth setting is in docs/REFERENCE.md
